insights: Centered, symmetric composition dominates with generous breathing room between major sections, creating a calm, premium feel.
Repeating pattern of headline + 'Explore →' CTA on the right establishes predictable visual rhythm across feature sections.
Heavy use of circular/spherical imagery and pill-shaped buttons creates a soft, approachable design language that contrasts with the technical product.
Color strategy uses vibrant gradients (orange, purple, teal, green) sparingly within cream/white containers to draw focus without overwhelming.
Grid-based cards (3-column at desktop) maintain strict alignment while carousel section breaks rhythm with organic, overlapping spheres.
